sections.title: Subject of the contract
paragraphs: VidiVerify is software for the technical analysis, checking and processing of video and audio files. It is a technical aid; there is no assurance that all errors, compatibility problems or quality impairments of a media file will be detected or fixed.
What is purchased is a license that unlocks paid features of the software. The purchase is a one-time payment; there is no subscription and no automatic renewal.

Use without a license is permitted free of charge for strictly private purposes. Any use beyond that, in particular in a commercial, professional, business or institutional environment, requires a license.

PRO unlocks the paid features of the purchased major version, for example version 1.x, including all updates within that major version. The license is valid for its program generation and all older ones; a later new major version, for example 2.x, is not automatically included.

LIFETIME additionally covers future major versions for as long as VidiVerify is developed or provided by the provider. The name LIFETIME does not imply any obligation to continue development, maintenance or provision for a minimum period or permanently.
The license is issued for one device and is bound to its device ID (VV-ID).

paragraphs: The “Request a license” form on vidiverify.de submits a request. The request is non-binding and is not an order; it does not create a contract.

The contract is concluded in three steps: the prospective customer submits the request and accepts these terms. The provider reviews the request and sends an invoice by email; this invoice is the provider's offer. The contract is concluded upon full payment of the amount stated in the invoice.
The invoice is usually sent within one to three business days of receiving the request.
The provider is not obliged to accept a request. In particular, it may decline a request if tax or legal processing is not possible in the individual case.
The contract language is German. Correspondence and support are also available in English; the German version is authoritative for the content of the contract.
The provider stores the contract text. These terms and the information on the right of withdrawal are sent to the customer in text form together with the invoice.

paragraphs: The prices stated at the time of the request or purchase apply. The amounts stated are total prices; there are no further costs.

For order requests, no VAT is shown under § 19 of the German VAT Act (small business rule). For purchases via the purchase page, Paddle as seller charges the VAT of the buyer's country; the prices shown on the purchase page include German VAT, and the amount shown in the checkout is binding.
For order requests, payment is made on the basis of the invoice sent and under the conditions stated there; for purchases via the purchase page, with the payment methods offered by Paddle.

sections.title: Delivery
paragraphs: For order requests, the license key is provided electronically after receipt of payment, usually within one to three business days. For purchases via the purchase page, the license is issued immediately after Paddle confirms the payment, shown on the purchase page and fetched by the application itself at its next start. In both cases, the license key can be retrieved through the application at any time, so it is not lost after a reinstallation or a change of computer. For a permanent move to another device, a message to the provider is sufficient.

For activation and recurring confirmation of the license, the application transmits only the device ID (VV-ID). The email address given at purchase is part of the license key and is not transmitted in the process.

Information, the declaration on early expiry and the handling of a withdrawal follow the terms Paddle provides in the checkout; the provider's information on the right of withdrawal does not apply to this route.

Essential contractual obligations are those whose fulfilment makes the proper performance of the contract possible in the first place and on whose observance the customer may regularly rely.

Otherwise, liability is excluded. This applies in particular to indirect damage, lost profit, lost savings, business interruption, third-party claims and damage resulting from decisions based on analysis results, check reports, ratings or repair attempts of the software.
